coverage.evaluation: Uterovaginal prolapse at hysterectomy distinguished from established post-hysterectomy vault prolapse; Alas advanced definition and small subgroup scoped.
coverage.treatment: Vaginal McCall, route-adapted fixation, extraperitoneal, extended-dissection and DLS variants retained; no cross-route or cross-study superiority transferred.
coverage.numbers: Cruikshank, Alas, Bushra, Schiavi, Novara, Parisi, Ettore, Arkan and ASPIRe denominators, follow-up and endpoints mapped to their populations; pseudo pooled ranking removed.
coverage.doseDeviceSafety: No dose or device. Ureteral kinking/obstruction and cystoscopic patency checking grounded in specific operative cohorts; small-cohort injury events not generalized.
coverage.anatomyTechnique: Uterosacral/pararectal and posterior-cuff/cul-de-sac operative description retained with Niblock source; exact suture/plane variants and operative videos remain to be independently checked.
coverage.followUp: Three-year prophylactic RCT, mean 2.8-year Bushra, median 8.9-year Schiavi, 13/15-month Novara, ~23-month Parisi and 12-month Arkan horizons separated.
coverage.importedDataFigures: No imported data or embedded figure. Both VideoCards preserved but not watched; no Niblock XML figure/supplement present.
coverage.references: All 14 inherited references retained; original Niblock technique and Cruikshank randomized comparison added as references 15–16; Cochrane citations contextualized.
coverage.currency: Arkan issue year corrected to 2026 (online 2025); 2025 Silva review scope checked; 2024 ASPIRe correctly identified and reused, not mistaken for SUPeR. Full 2017–2026 papers/figures remain open.
